description:
Job Description: 
 
 Must Have Skills: 
 • Must have Demandware implementation experience 
 • Excellent Communication and customer facing skills 
 • Experience with merchant tools and functions like business manager 
 
 Desired Skills: 
 • ECommerce Domain Experience 
 • Experience in scripting skills 
 • Full stack development including front-end and back-end 
 
 Job Roles / Responsibilities: 
 
 Ø Provide technical design for development tasks 
 Ø Plan migration sequence with the help of Architect 
 Ø Define Data Migration approach (customer, product, catalog etc.) with the help of Architect 
 Ø Participate in the daily onsite and offshore calls and ensures offshore complies to the design and code standards and process 
 Ø Review the entire design and code of offshore and provides comments at the appropriate stage of the project 
 Ø Address technical issues and challenges. 
 Ø Hands-on development as needed 
 Ø Perform merchant support functions lie setting up promos, content, couppons, products, banners, landing pages etc. 
 Ø Provide technical guidance around current Operational, Support, QA and Release Management processes with Vendor SMEs 
 Ø Work with the eCom PM / Solution Strategist / Functional Lead at Onsite for the agile activities. 
 Ø Support the eCom Demandware Tech Architect in Build and Release Management activities 
 Ø Support the eCom Demandware Tech Architect in Code Branching strategy 
 Ø Leverage the Demandware assets and solutions wherever applicable (few examples – Single page checkout, Content migration utility etc) 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
